pr_body:
According spec, for the same iv index, iv update flag should trans to false, when iv update procedure complete.

When local environment has attack-node
to store old network beacon(1,1), and re-send same network beacon(1,1) after 192hours, will cause whole bluetooth mesh network broke.

Fixes #60258

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: Mesh: A node can enter IV Update in Progress state if old SNB with IV Update flag set to 1 is resent
issue_context.body:
A node can enter IV Update in Progress state if an old SNB with the current IV Index and IV Update flag set to 1 was resent.

The node shall not accept such Secure Network Beacon.

review_comments:
Could you add any `LOG_DBG` or `LOG_ERR` message before `return false`? 
IV update procedure is quite difficult to debug\investigate. It will help in maintenance.
